summary: Brantley County tower listed only on tnlandforms.us. No history, staffing or fate found in any source we could read; site status unknown.

evidence.supports: Brantley County location and list number GA392 for the tower named waynesville (72 is the elevation in feet, not the tower number)
names for towers from number 73 on are the author's own creation
evidence.quote: For towers 73 and above, names are my creation.

notes_for_editor: Stub, low confidence. The only source is the tnlandforms list (county and coordinates). Wikipedia's Waynesville, Georgia page and the GAGenWeb Waynesville history page do not mention a tower. The RootsWeb Brantley County history pages returned HTTP 403, so they were not read. A RootsWeb search snippet mentioned a 'fire tower ridge' in Brantley County history. That lead is unverified and not used in the story. Do not confuse this record with Trail Ridge (tnlandforms GA153, also Brantley County), a different tower that has a Wikimedia Commons photo. No status, access or staffing found. The story is well under the 120-word target.
